name: Koldunic Sorcery — 2 Intermediate — Conjure Lesser Demon

system.description:
This ritual evokes one of the lesser demons that haunt the Slavic lands. These "demons" have no connection to Infernal beings; they resemble the spirits revered by werewolves, and the relationship between sorcerer and demon is that of master and vassal — albeit a highly malicious, intractable vassal, never a pact of equals. All such demons bear names, which the koldun must learn, and all must be "sworn" to her by accepting a point of her blood. A koldun may retain a number of demons equal to her Charisma or Intimidation, whichever is higher; demons are not bound and must be coaxed or cowed into service. A lesser demon can appear in virtually any shape, many resembling ordinary animals, some freakish indeed.

System: Requires a Blood Point spilled as part of the casting and a successful Intelligence + Hearth Wisdom roll (difficulty 7). Success binds one named lesser demon into the koldun's service until she releases it, loses control of it, or exceeds her retinue limit.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis I: Masters of the State, Book Two: Tzimisce
